captions.detailed: A commercial bar blender consisting of a wide, tapered rectangular base in matte black and a large cylindrical metal jar in light gray with a black handle. A flat black lid sits on top of the jar, secured by a small hinge. The jar locks onto the base via a revolute bayonet twist joint, the lid opens via a revolute hinge at its edge, and the blade assembly inside rotates continuously about the vertical axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a commercial bar blender with a wide rectangular base and a cylindrical jar. The model must feature three articulations: a revolute bayonet joint to lock/unlock the jar onto the base, a revolute hinge for the lid on top of the jar, and a continuous rotation joint for the internal blade assembly.
captions.factory: Construct the base using a tapered box primitive with rounded corners. Build the jar as a hollowed cylinder, adding a sweep-defined handle and a thin rim. Model the lid as a flat cylinder with a small rectangular hinge block. Define three joints: a revolute joint for locking the jar to the base, a revolute joint for opening the lid, and a continuous joint for the internal blade rotation.
